public_source_basis.claim_used: sums of high-frequency squared returns measure completed realized variation without supplying future direction.
public_source_basis.claim_used_2: open interest measures outstanding leveraged inventory and is used only through observations available by decision time.

mechanism.claim: When an already high-variation completed eight-hour BTC auction shifts unusually large quadratic variation into its final two hours, reverses the prior six-hour direction, and expands open interest, new leveraged inventory is sponsoring a late directional takeover. Follow the completed final-two-hour direction for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed final-two-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTVIR requires early/late direction agreement on a once-daily 24-hour clock. HVOILVI uses OI sign as a direction transform without requiring a directional takeover. HVOILVT requires strict early/late disagreement plus current OI expansion and follows only the late direction. No prior event set or diagnostic control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: overall variation rank>=0.65 and late-two-hour variance-share rank>=0.75
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset OI-sponsored late-direction takeover events are absent from Gross9 definitions

features.price_block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT five-minute bars aggregated from 480 unique one-minute rows in [D-8h,D)
features.early_return: log(close of bar 72/open of bar 1) over the completed first six hours, finite strict nonzero
features.late_return: log(last completed close/open of bar 73) over the completed final two hours, finite strict nonzero
features.directional_takeover: strict signs of early_return and late_return are opposite
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum of 96 squared five-minute intrabar log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.late_variance_share: sum of final 24 squared returns divided by sum of all 96 squared returns
features.oi_path: 97 exact positive BTCUSDT period=5m observations from D-8h through D; timestamp<=D; no imputation
features.oi_change: log(last/first OI), finite and strictly positive
features.causal_ranks: separate strict-prior midranks of realized variation and late variance share over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded
features.eligibility: variation rank>=0.65, late-variance-share rank>=0.75, directional takeover, and OI expansion
features.ignition: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid decision ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger
features.availability: D after every completed bar and OI observation is available

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: not a signal input; q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent late-direction takeover sponsored by expanding leveraged inventory

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure: source, novelty, train, test, eval, final; no threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair.
